description: Loudness over time of a library video or sound file: RMS in dBFS per step (−100 = silence), the quiet stretches (pauses, dead air) and the loudest moments (a clap, laughter, applause), all in seconds of the file. Finds where the talking is without transcribing. Free. A long file takes a while the first time: it may answer with a job id (poll get_job).

media.description: Media id from list_media, or the file name

project.description: Project id from list_projects or create_project

name: get_media_levels
title: Hear a file as numbers
